snippet.title: Bloomsome - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Bloomsome is a dystopian make-over puzzle game that reflects upon the issue with unfair beauty standards through shaping body structures of botanical characters. Check out the Bloomsome trailer to see what to expect ahead of the game's launch on PC, Mac, iOS, and Android.
